title: Best decision for our team
name: Sarah Mitchell
content: This plugin transformed how we collect and display customer feedback. Setup took minutes and the blocks look stunning on every device. Highly recommended for any team that values social proof.

title: Beautiful and flexible
name: David Chen
content: The layout options are endless. We switched from a carousel to a masonry grid in one click and it just worked. Our conversion rate noticeably improved after adding real testimonials to the landing page.

title: Support is top notch
name: Amara Okafor
content: Whenever I had a question the team responded fast with clear answers. The Gutenberg blocks feel native and the styling controls give us full creative freedom without touching code.

title: Exactly what we needed
name: Lucas Bauer
content: We tried three other testimonial plugins before this one. None matched the performance and design quality. The query builder makes it trivial to filter reviews by rating or category.

title: Clients love it
name: Priya Sharma
content: I build sites for clients and this is now a standard part of every project. The premade patterns save hours and the result always looks professional and polished.

title: Smooth and reliable
name: Emily Carter
content: The AJAX search and live filter let our shoppers find relevant reviews instantly. No page reloads, no lag. It feels like a premium experience straight out of the box.

title: Worth every penny
name: Marco Rossi
content: Showing real guest reviews on our homepage built trust fast. Bookings went up within weeks. The star rating display is clean and the whole thing loads quickly.
